Advertising is dishonest and deceptive. When signing up for the Playmore membership, it appears that you will only pay $20 to get an hour of play. That’s not true. Since you are required to book a bay through the app, there’s no way to get around the 25% “deposit”. During peak times, you may have to pay almost an additional $20 to get a bay. When booking online, the fee should not be called a “deposit”, it should be called a reservation fee. Most people think of a deposit as being refundable or the money going towards the total price of the product. You are just charging a fee. If you want to be more transparent, advertise the Playmore membership with 1 hour of play + 25% reservation fee (fee will vary depending upon booking time and day of the week). This may all be included somewhere in the fine print, but it’s not obvious on the main offers page. I did see before signing up that I’m locked in for 3 months, but I will be canceling immediately after due to the deceptive advertising.
